1922-12-29 plus 303 days:  
1923 is not a leap year (1924 is). Days in 1922 after Dec 29: 2 days left (Dec 30, 31) → 303 - 2 = 301 days into 1923.  
Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) = 243 days. 301 - 243 = 58 days into September. September has 30 days, so 58 days means Oct 28 (since 30 days in Sept → Sept 30 is day 30, Oct 1 is day 31, …, Oct 28 is day 58).  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1923-10-28
